vocab.sentence: The king was talking to a little boy.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 國王當時正和一個小男孩說話。

vocab.sentence: The toad was sitting beside the hole.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 蟾蜍當時正坐在洞旁。

vocab.sentence: We saw a fox on our way home.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們在回家的路上看到一隻狐狸。

vocab.sentence: My shoes were wet after I crossed the river.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我過河後，鞋子都溼了。

vocab.sentence: The children were playing in the mud then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 孩子們當時正在泥巴裡玩。

vocab.sentence: Suddenly, a snake fell out of the tree.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 突然，一條蛇從樹上掉了下來。

vocab.sentence: The hole was deep, so we stayed away.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那個洞很深，所以我們離得遠遠的。

vocab.sentence: A rat was hiding in the hole then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 一隻老鼠當時正躲在洞裡。

vocab.sentence: The baby was crying when her mother arrived.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 媽媽到達時，寶寶正在哭。

vocab.sentence: A bus went by while we were talking.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們說話時，一輛公車經過。

vocab.sentence: I was sitting beside my sister then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我當時正坐在妹妹旁邊。

vocab.sentence: I washed my hands before I ate dinner.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我吃晚餐前先洗了手。

vocab.sentence: The game was difficult, but we kept trying.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這個遊戲很難，但我們繼續嘗試。

vocab.sentence: He was reading the message over and over.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 他當時正一遍又一遍地讀那則訊息。

vocab.sentence: A butterfly was flying over the flowers.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 一隻蝴蝶當時正在花朵上方飛舞。

vocab.sentence: The children were laughing when I walked in.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我走進去時，孩子們正在大笑。

vocab.sentence: It was possible to finish the work before dinner.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 晚餐前完成工作是有可能的。

vocab.sentence: We passed by the park at half past five.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們在五點半經過公園。

vocab.sentence: The monkey was climbing the tree then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 猴子當時正在爬樹。

vocab.sentence: The coin fell to the bottom of the hole.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 硬幣掉到了洞底。

vocab.sentence: The flower died before we came home.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們回家前，那朵花就枯死了。

vocab.sentence: I was tired after I climbed the mountain.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 爬山後，我很累。

vocab.sentence: The lost boy felt helpless and cried.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 迷路的男孩感到無助，哭了起來。

vocab.sentence: We finally arrived at a quarter to six.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們終於在五點四十五分到達。

vocab.sentence: Dad arrived while we were having dinner.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 爸爸到達時，我們正在吃晚餐。

vocab.sentence: The girl caught the ball in time.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 女孩及時接住了球。

vocab.sentence: I was surprised when I heard the news.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 聽到這個消息時，我很驚訝。

vocab.sentence: A snake was sleeping under the tree.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 一條蛇當時正在樹下睡覺。

vocab.sentence: Mom was typing a message at nine last night.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 媽媽昨晚九點正在打訊息。

vocab.sentence: I read your message before I went out.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我出門前讀了你的訊息。

vocab.sentence: My cellphone rang while I was studying.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我讀書時，手機響了。

vocab.sentence: The deaf boy was reading beside the window.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那位聽不見的男孩當時正在窗邊看書。

vocab.sentence: I heard a cry while I was walking home.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我走路回家時聽到一聲哭喊。

vocab.sentence: We were cheering our friends on at the game.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 比賽時，我們正在為朋友加油。

vocab.sentence: A bat was flying above the house then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 一隻蝙蝠當時正在房子上方飛。

vocab.sentence: The fox ran away when it saw us.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 狐狸看到我們時就跑走了。

vocab.sentence: A rat was eating beside the door.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 一隻老鼠當時正在門旁吃東西。

vocab.sentence: The hen was looking for food at seven.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 母雞七點時正在找食物。

phrases.sentence: We were going to the park at that time.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我們那時正要去公園。

phrases.phrase: on the/所有格 + way (+ to + 地方)
phrases.sentence: I met my friend on my way home.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我在回家途中遇見朋友。

phrases.phrase: be full of... / be filled with...
phrases.sentence: The room was full of flowers that day.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 那天房間裡滿是花。

phrases.sentence: The women were taking selfies in the garden then.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 那些女士當時正在花園裡自拍。

phrases.sentence: The boy fell into a hole while he was running.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 男孩跑步時掉進了洞裡。

phrases.sentence: The little boy was crying for help last night.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 那個小男孩昨晚正在大聲求救。

phrases.sentence: They went past the restaurant after school yesterday.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 他們昨天放學後經過那間餐廳。

phrases.sentence: When we got to the park, we saw rabbits.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我們到公園時，看見了兔子。

phrases.sentence: He did not give up after he fell.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 他跌倒後沒有放棄。

phrases.sentence: The frog jumped away when we came near.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我們靠近時，青蛙跳走了。

phrases.phrase: over and over again = over and over = again and again
phrases.sentence: She was reading the story over and over again.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 她當時正一遍又一遍地讀那個故事。

phrases.sentence: The butterflies flew away when the boy arrived.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 男孩到達時，蝴蝶飛走了。

phrases.sentence: The poor old man fell to the bottom of the hole.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 那位可憐的老人跌到了洞底。

phrases.sentence: At first, I did not believe him.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 起初，我不相信他。

phrases.sentence: We were listening to the teacher at that time.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我們當時正在聽老師說話。

phrases.sentence: Jeremy saw the movie many times last year.
phrases.sentence_chinese: Jeremy 去年看了那部電影很多次。

phrases.sentence: She gave it another try before she went home.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 她回家前又試了一次。

phrases.sentence: The rabbit jumped out of the box then.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 兔子當時跳出了箱子。

phrases.phrase: arrive at + 小地方 / in + 大地方
phrases.sentence: We arrived at Nancy's home at six.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我們六點到達 Nancy 家。

phrases.sentence: The spider saved the butterfly in time.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 蜘蛛及時救了蝴蝶。

phrases.phrase: all the other + 複數可數名詞
phrases.sentence: All the other students were reading at that time.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 所有其他學生當時都在看書。

phrases.sentence: They got out of the house before dinner.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 他們晚餐前離開了房子。

phrases.sentence: My dad was talking on his cellphone then.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 爸爸當時正在用手機說話。

phrases.sentence: We were cheering her on when she fell.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 她跌倒時，我們正在為她加油。

phrases.sentence: We did not go out because of the rain.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我們因為下雨而沒有出門。

tips.label: 過去正在做
tips.text: 過去某個時刻正在做的事：主詞 + was/were + V-ing。I/he/she/it 用 was；you/we/they 用 were。

tips.label: 否定與問句
tips.text: 否定在 was/were 後加 not；問句把 was/were 放到主詞前。Were you typing? → Yes, I was.

tips.label: 先後順序
tips.text: before = 在……之前；after = 在……之後。先確定哪件事先發生，再選連接詞。

tips.label: 正在做時發生另一件事
tips.text: I was reading when the phone rang. 正在看書是背景，電話響是發生的事件。

tips.label: 兩件事同時進行
tips.text: While I was typing, Mom was cooking. while 引出的活動進行時，另一個活動也正在進行。

tips.label: 時間這樣說
tips.text: 7:20 = twenty past seven；7:50 = ten to eight；7:15 = a quarter past seven；7:30 = half past seven。

notes.title: 過去進行式：肯定、否定
notes.description: 描述過去某時刻正在做的事。I/he/she/it 與單數主詞用 was；you/we/they 與複數主詞用 were。
examples: The ant was laughing at the spider then.（螞蟻當時正在嘲笑蜘蛛。）
They were not picking flowers at that time.（他們那時沒有在摘花。）

notes.title: 過去進行式：問句與簡答
notes.rule: Was/Were + 主詞 + V-ing...? / What + was/were + 主詞 + doing...?
notes.description: Yes/No 問句把 was/were 移到主詞前；簡答保留 was/were。疑問詞問句也要注意倒裝。
examples: Were the children running at seven yesterday morning?（孩子們昨天早上七點正在跑步嗎？）
Yes, they were. / No, they were not.
What was your brother doing at that time?（你哥哥那時正在做什麼？）

notes.title: when、before、after 與事件順序
notes.rule: When/Before/After + 主詞 + 動詞, 主詞 + 動詞.
notes.description: when 表示當……時；before 表示在……之前；after 表示在……之後。子句也可放在後面，通常不加逗號。before/after 後可接完整子句，或在語意主詞適當時接 V-ing。
examples: Before Ben ate dinner, he washed his hands.（Ben 吃晚餐前先洗手。）
After washing his hands, Ben ate dinner.（Ben 洗手後吃晚餐。）

notes.title: when：進行中的背景與插入事件
notes.rule: 主詞 + was/were + V-ing + when + 主詞 + 過去式
notes.description: 用過去進行式描述當時持續中的活動，以過去簡單式描述發生的事件。不可把 when 一律視為只能接某一時態。
examples: The girls were dancing when I arrived at the party.（我到派對時，女孩們正在跳舞。）

notes.title: while：同時進行或活動期間發生事件
notes.rule: While + 主詞 + was/were + V-ing, 主詞 + 過去式 / was/were + V-ing
notes.description: 本課用 while 子句描述持續中的活動；另一件事可為突然發生的事件，也可為同時進行的活動。需依語境判斷，不將所有 while 句都機械套成兩個進行式。
examples: Tina went by while David was buying chocolate.（David 買巧克力時，Tina 經過。）
While Mr. Lin was picking fruit, Mrs. Lin was planting a tree.（林先生摘水果時，林太太正在種樹。）

notes.title: 時間：past／after、to、quarter、half
notes.rule: 分鐘 + past/after + 當下鐘點；剩餘分鐘 + to + 下一個鐘點
notes.description: 1–30 分可用 past/after；31–59 分常改用 to，分鐘以 60 減原分鐘，鐘點加 1。a quarter = 15 分鐘；half past = ……點半。
examples: 2:10 = ten past two / ten after two
4:50 = ten to five
1:15 = a quarter past one
6:45 = a quarter to seven
3:30 = half past three

notes.title: V-ing 的常見變化
notes.rule: 一般加 -ing；不發音 e 結尾先去 e；部分短母音 + 單一子音結尾字需重複子音；ie 改 y 再加 -ing。
notes.description: 本課常見：type → typing、climb → climbing、run → running、sit → sitting、die → dying。不能把過去式直接放在 was/were 後當成進行式。
examples: The boy was typing a message then.（男孩當時正在打訊息。）
The hen was sitting beside the tree.（母雞當時正坐在樹旁。）

notes.title: before/after 後接子句或 V-ing
notes.rule: before/after + 主詞 + 動詞；before/after + V-ing
notes.description: I ate before I left. 的 before 後是完整子句。I ate before leaving. 的 leaving 沒有另寫主詞，通常由主句的 I 做這個動作。若兩個動作主詞不同，保留完整子句，避免誤會。
examples: After reading the message, I called Dad.（讀完訊息後，我打電話給爸爸。）
I closed the door before the baby fell asleep.（寶寶睡著前，我關上門。）

notes.title: 時間連接詞不是時態開關
notes.rule: 先看事件的時間與進行狀態，再選動詞。
notes.description: when 可以連接過去事件，也可出現在現在的習慣句。while 常引出持續中的背景，但不代表兩邊一定都要用進行式。was happy、were tired 是 be + 形容詞，並不是過去進行式。
examples: When I heard the news, I was surprised.（我聽到消息時很驚訝。）
While I was climbing, a bird flew by.（我攀爬時，一隻鳥飛過。）

notes.title: going to 後面的詞決定意思
notes.rule: was/were going to + 地方；was/were going to + 原形動詞
notes.description: 接地方時，表示當時正前往某地；接原形動詞時，表示當時打算做某事。兩種句型不要混在一起。
examples: We were going to the park then.（我們當時正前往公園。）
We were going to play in the park.（我們當時打算在公園玩。）

quiz.question: At eight last night, I ___ typing a message to my cousin.
quiz.hint: at eight last night 指過去的特定時刻；主詞 I 用 was，搭配 typing 表示當時正在打字。

quiz.question: The children ___ climbing a tree when Grandma called them.
quiz.hint: climbing 前需要過去式 be 動詞；The children 是複數，所以用 were。

quiz.question: At six yesterday morning, the hen ___ under a tree.
quiz.hint: at six yesterday morning 指過去某時刻正在進行的活動；the hen 是單數，用 was sleeping。

quiz.question: A rat ___ across the kitchen when I turned on the light.
quiz.hint: turned on 是過去事件；老鼠當時正在跑，且 A rat 是單數，用 was running。

quiz.question: Mom did not hear the doorbell because she ___ on her cellphone at that time.
quiz.hint: did not hear 和 at that time 表示過去情境；she 搭配 was talking，說明當時正在講電話。

quiz.question: A: Were the boys playing in the mud then? B: No, they ___. They were inside.
quiz.hint: 問句使用 Were，主詞為 they，否定簡答用 weren’t；不能改用 didn’t。

quiz.question: Dad ___ watching the game at nine last night. He was washing the dishes instead.
quiz.hint: instead 表示爸爸當時在洗碗而沒有看比賽；Dad 是單數，否定進行式用 wasn’t watching。

quiz.question: The foxes ___ looking for food at midnight yesterday.
quiz.hint: at midnight yesterday 指過去某時刻；The foxes 是複數，用 were looking。

quiz.question: A: ___ your brother taking a selfie when you found him? B: Yes, he was.
quiz.hint: 過去進行式問句以 Was/Were 開頭；your brother 是單數，且答句為 he was，所以用 Was。

quiz.question: A: ___ the butterflies flying over the garden then? B: Yes, they were.
quiz.hint: the butterflies 是複數；過去進行式問句用 Were + 主詞 + V-ing。

quiz.question: A: What ___ you doing when the king arrived? B: I was cleaning the floor.
quiz.hint: What were you doing...? 問過去正在做什麼；問句主詞 you 用 were，即使回答時 I 用 was。

quiz.question: A: ___ was the little girl doing beside the hole? B: She was crying for help.
quiz.hint: 答句 crying for help 說明正在做的活動，因此用 What 詢問做什麼，而非地點、時間或原因。

quiz.question: A: Where were you sitting during the show? B: I ___ beside my sister.
quiz.hint: 問句 were you sitting 指過去；回答主詞改為 I，所以用 was sitting。

quiz.question: A: Was the deaf boy reading at that time? B: Yes, he ___.
quiz.hint: Was 開頭的進行式問句以 was 簡答；he 是單數，不能用 were 或 did。

quiz.question: A: Were you listening to the teacher then, Ben? B: Yes, I ___.
quiz.hint: 問句的 you 用 were；Ben 以 I 回答時，過去式 be 動詞要改為 was。

quiz.question: A: Were you and May cheering the team on? B: Yes, we ___.
quiz.hint: 回答主詞 we 是複數，沿用過去進行式的 be 動詞 were。

quiz.question: At ten last night, my parents were ___ for their missing cellphone.
quiz.hint: were 後接 V-ing 才構成過去進行式，表示昨晚十點正在找手機。

quiz.question: When the rain started, the children were ___ into the house.
quiz.hint: were 後接 V-ing；run 的進行式為 running，表示孩子當時正在跑進屋裡。

quiz.question: The little boy was ___ a message when the teacher walked in.
quiz.hint: was + V-ing 描述老師走進來時正在做的事；type 去掉不發音的 e 再加 -ing，成為 typing。

quiz.question: At that moment, we ___ laughing at the toad. We were watching it quietly.
quiz.hint: 後句 quietly 表示我們安靜觀看而沒有嘲笑牠；we 用 weren’t，組成否定過去進行式。

quiz.question: The tired woman was ___ beside the window at that time.
quiz.hint: 過去進行式需要 V-ing；sit 要重複 t 再加 -ing，表示坐著的正確形式是 sitting。

quiz.question: The flower was ___ because it had no water when we found it.
quiz.hint: was 後用 V-ing；die 的 ie 改成 y 再加 -ing，成為 dying，表示當時正在枯死。

quiz.question: We reached the station at 8:00. The train left at 8:10, so we arrived ___ it left.
quiz.hint: 我們八點到、火車八點十分離開，抵達較早，應用 before 表示在火車離開之前。

quiz.question: The rain stopped at 3:00. We went out at 3:20, so we went out ___ the rain stopped.
quiz.hint: 雨三點停、我們三點二十分才出門；出門較晚，用 after 表示在雨停之後。

quiz.question: After ___ the wet floor, Dad put the mop away.
quiz.hint: After 後沒有另寫主詞，接 cleaning 這個 V-ing 形式；清理地板和收拖把的人都是 Dad。

quiz.question: Lily read the message before ___ her cellphone into her bag.
quiz.hint: before 後沒有主詞，接 V-ing；put 要重複 t 再加 -ing，成為 putting。

quiz.question: After the baby ___ asleep last night, Mom turned off the light.
quiz.hint: After 後已有主詞 the baby，需要完整子句的動詞；last night 和 turned 表示過去，使用 fell。

quiz.question: Before we ___ the muddy field yesterday, we put on our boots.
quiz.hint: before 後有主詞 we；yesterday 表示過去，用 entered 完成子句。不能只有 entering 而沒有 be 動詞。

quiz.question: First, Sam finished his homework. Next, he fed the hen. He fed the hen ___ finishing his homework.
quiz.hint: First 和 Next 明示先完成作業、再餵雞，因此用 after finishing。before 會顛倒順序；when finishing 表示完成當下，不符合這裡的先後線索；because 不能直接接 finishing。

quiz.question: The shop closed at 9:00. We left at 8:40, twenty minutes ___ it closed.
quiz.hint: 八點四十分比九點早二十分鐘；twenty minutes before 表示早二十分鐘。

quiz.question: While I was drawing a butterfly yesterday, my sister ___ a picture of a fox.
quiz.hint: while 描述同時進行的活動；主詞 my sister 是單數，過去當時正在畫畫用 was painting。

quiz.question: The children ___ a deep hole when they suddenly heard a loud cry.
quiz.hint: heard 是過去發生的事件；The children 是複數，當時正在挖洞用 were digging。

quiz.question: While Grandma was making soup last night, the lights suddenly ___ out.
quiz.hint: was making 是過去進行中的背景；突然停電是發生的事件，用過去式 went。

quiz.question: I was taking a selfie when a butterfly suddenly ___ on my hand.
quiz.hint: was taking 是背景動作；蝴蝶突然停到手上是過去事件，用 landed。

quiz.question: While the bats ___ above the lake, we were watching from a boat.
quiz.hint: 主句 were watching 表示過去當時在看；the bats 是複數，同時飛行用 were flying。

quiz.question: When I opened the door, the guests ___ for the king inside.
quiz.hint: opened 是過去事件；門打開時賓客已在等候，複數主詞 the guests 用 were waiting。

quiz.question: While I was looking for my keys, Dad ___ them under the sofa.
quiz.hint: was looking 是持續尋找的背景；爸爸找到鑰匙是過去發生的事件，用 found。

quiz.question: When the snake ___ out of the box, I was standing beside the table.
quiz.hint: 主句 was standing 表示過去背景；蛇出來是當時發生的事件，使用 come 的過去式 came。

quiz.question: A: Were the girls singing while you were typing? B: No, they ___. They were reading.
quiz.hint: while 連接同時進行的活動；女孩們當時在讀書而非唱歌，they 的否定簡答用 weren’t。

quiz.question: Mom ___ the wet clothes while Dad was washing the dishes.
quiz.hint: Dad was washing 表示過去進行中的活動；Mom 同時在晾衣服，單數主詞用 was hanging。

quiz.question: The clock shows 7:20. It is twenty ___ seven.
quiz.hint: 7:20 是七點過二十分，用 twenty past seven；twenty to seven 則是 6:40。

quiz.question: The bus leaves at 8:50, or ten to ___.
quiz.hint: 8:50 距離九點還有十分鐘；to 後接下一個鐘點 nine。

quiz.question: It is 3:45 now. It is a ___ to four.
quiz.hint: 3:45 距離四點還有十五分鐘；a quarter 表示一刻鐘，也就是十五分鐘。

quiz.question: Dinner is at 6:30, or ___ past six.
quiz.hint: 6:30 是六點過三十分；half 表示半小時，half past six 就是六點半。

quiz.question: The cellphone shows 11:55. It is five ___ twelve.
quiz.hint: 11:55 距離十二點還有五分鐘，用 five to twelve。past/after twelve 表示十二點過後。

quiz.question: The game starts at 1:15, or a quarter ___ one.
quiz.hint: 1:15 是一點過十五分，用 a quarter past one；a quarter to one 是 12:45。

quiz.question: We arrived at 10:40, or twenty to ___.
quiz.hint: 10:40 距離十一點還有二十分鐘，因此是 twenty to eleven。

quiz.question: The clock shows 4:10. It is ten ___ four.
quiz.hint: 4:10 可說 ten past four 或 ten after four；選項只有 after 能表示四點過十分。

quiz.question: The train leaves at 9:35, or ___ to ten.
quiz.hint: to 的分鐘要用 60 減目前分鐘：60 − 35 = 25，所以 9:35 是 twenty-five to ten。

quiz.question: We will meet at a quarter to two. The digital clock should show ___.
quiz.hint: a quarter to two 是距離兩點還有十五分鐘，也就是 1:45；不是兩點十五分。

vocab.sentence: The king was talking to a little boy.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 國王當時正和一個小男孩說話。

vocab.sentence: The toad was sitting beside the hole.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 蟾蜍當時正坐在洞旁。

vocab.sentence: We saw a fox on our way home.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們在回家的路上看到一隻狐狸。

vocab.sentence: My shoes were wet after I crossed the river.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我過河後，鞋子都溼了。

vocab.sentence: The children were playing in the mud then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 孩子們當時正在泥巴裡玩。

vocab.sentence: Suddenly, a snake fell out of the tree.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 突然，一條蛇從樹上掉了下來。

vocab.sentence: The hole was deep, so we stayed away.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那個洞很深，所以我們離得遠遠的。

vocab.sentence: A rat was hiding in the hole then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 一隻老鼠當時正躲在洞裡。

vocab.sentence: The baby was crying when her mother arrived.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 媽媽到達時，寶寶正在哭。

vocab.sentence: A bus went by while we were talking.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們說話時，一輛公車經過。

vocab.sentence: I was sitting beside my sister then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我當時正坐在妹妹旁邊。

vocab.sentence: I washed my hands before I ate dinner.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我吃晚餐前先洗了手。

vocab.sentence: The game was difficult, but we kept trying.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這個遊戲很難，但我們繼續嘗試。

vocab.sentence: He was reading the message over and over.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 他當時正一遍又一遍地讀那則訊息。

vocab.sentence: A butterfly was flying over the flowers.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 一隻蝴蝶當時正在花朵上方飛舞。

vocab.sentence: The children were laughing when I walked in.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我走進去時，孩子們正在大笑。

vocab.sentence: It was possible to finish the work before dinner.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 晚餐前完成工作是有可能的。

vocab.sentence: We passed by the park at half past five.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們在五點半經過公園。

vocab.sentence: The monkey was climbing the tree then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 猴子當時正在爬樹。

vocab.sentence: The coin fell to the bottom of the hole.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 硬幣掉到了洞底。

vocab.sentence: The flower died before we came home.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們回家前，那朵花就枯死了。

vocab.sentence: I was tired after I climbed the mountain.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 爬山後，我很累。

vocab.sentence: The lost boy felt helpless and cried.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 迷路的男孩感到無助，哭了起來。

vocab.sentence: We finally arrived at a quarter to six.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們終於在五點四十五分到達。

vocab.sentence: Dad arrived while we were having dinner.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 爸爸到達時，我們正在吃晚餐。

vocab.sentence: The girl caught the ball in time.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 女孩及時接住了球。

vocab.sentence: I was surprised when I heard the news.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 聽到這個消息時，我很驚訝。

vocab.sentence: A snake was sleeping under the tree.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 一條蛇當時正在樹下睡覺。

vocab.sentence: Mom was typing a message at nine last night.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 媽媽昨晚九點正在打訊息。

vocab.sentence: I read your message before I went out.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我出門前讀了你的訊息。

vocab.sentence: My cellphone rang while I was studying.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我讀書時，手機響了。

vocab.sentence: The deaf boy was reading beside the window.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那位聽不見的男孩當時正在窗邊看書。

vocab.sentence: I heard a cry while I was walking home.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我走路回家時聽到一聲哭喊。

vocab.sentence: We were cheering our friends on at the game.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 比賽時，我們正在為朋友加油。

vocab.sentence: A bat was flying above the house then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 一隻蝙蝠當時正在房子上方飛。

vocab.sentence: The fox ran away when it saw us.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 狐狸看到我們時就跑走了。

vocab.sentence: A rat was eating beside the door.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 一隻老鼠當時正在門旁吃東西。

vocab.sentence: The hen was looking for food at seven.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 母雞七點時正在找食物。

phrases.sentence: We were going to the park at that time.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我們那時正要去公園。

phrases.sentence: I met my friend on my way home.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我在回家途中遇見朋友。

phrases.sentence: The room was full of flowers that day.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 那天房間裡滿是花。

phrases.sentence: The women were taking selfies in the garden then.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 那些女士當時正在花園裡自拍。

phrases.sentence: The boy fell into a hole while he was running.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 男孩跑步時掉進了洞裡。

phrases.sentence: The little boy was crying for help last night.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 那個小男孩昨晚正在大聲求救。

phrases.sentence: They went past the restaurant after school yesterday.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 他們昨天放學後經過那間餐廳。

phrases.sentence: When we got to the park, we saw rabbits.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我們到公園時，看見了兔子。

phrases.sentence: He did not give up after he fell.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 他跌倒後沒有放棄。

phrases.sentence: The frog jumped away when we came near.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我們靠近時，青蛙跳走了。

phrases.sentence: She was reading the story over and over again.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 她當時正一遍又一遍地讀那個故事。

phrases.sentence: The butterflies flew away when the boy arrived.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 男孩到達時，蝴蝶飛走了。

phrases.sentence: The poor old man fell to the bottom of the hole.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 那位可憐的老人跌到了洞底。

phrases.sentence: At first, I did not believe him.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 起初，我不相信他。

phrases.sentence: We were listening to the teacher at that time.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我們當時正在聽老師說話。

phrases.sentence: Jeremy saw the movie many times last year.
phrases.sentence_chinese: Jeremy 去年看了那部電影很多次。

phrases.sentence: She gave it another try before she went home.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 她回家前又試了一次。

phrases.sentence: The rabbit jumped out of the box then.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 兔子當時跳出了箱子。

phrases.sentence: We arrived at Nancy's home at six.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我們六點到達 Nancy 家。

phrases.sentence: The spider saved the butterfly in time.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 蜘蛛及時救了蝴蝶。

phrases.sentence: All the other students were reading at that time.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 所有其他學生當時都在看書。

phrases.sentence: They got out of the house before dinner.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 他們晚餐前離開了房子。

phrases.sentence: My dad was talking on his cellphone then.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 爸爸當時正在用手機說話。

phrases.sentence: We were cheering her on when she fell.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 她跌倒時，我們正在為她加油。

phrases.sentence: We did not go out because of the rain.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我們因為下雨而沒有出門。

grammar.sentence: The king was reading beside the window then.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 國王當時正在窗邊讀書。

grammar.sentence: We arrived after the rain stopped yesterday.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們昨天在雨停之後到達。

grammar.sentence: Were the girls taking selfies in the garden?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那些女孩當時正在花園裡自拍嗎？

grammar.sentence: It was a quarter past three then.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 當時是三點十五分。

grammar.sentence: While I was typing, Dad was cooking dinner.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我打字時，爸爸正在煮晚餐。

grammar.sentence: The toad was not sitting in the mud.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 蟾蜍當時沒有坐在泥巴裡。

grammar.sentence: I heard a cry when I opened the door.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我開門時聽見一聲哭喊。

grammar.sentence: After reading the message, she called her mother.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 讀完訊息後，她打電話給媽媽。

grammar.sentence: What were you doing beside the hole?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你當時正在洞旁做什麼？

grammar.sentence: The train arrived at twenty to seven.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 火車在六點四十分到達。

grammar.sentence: The boys were climbing when the rain started.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 開始下雨時，男孩們正在攀爬。

grammar.sentence: Before leaving home, I fed the hen.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 離家前，我餵了母雞。

grammar.sentence: Was your brother cheering the players on then?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你哥哥當時正在為選手們加油嗎？

grammar.sentence: While the children were sleeping, a bat flew by.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 孩子們睡覺時，一隻蝙蝠飛過。

grammar.sentence: We were not laughing at the little boy.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們當時沒有嘲笑那個小男孩。

grammar.sentence: The movie started at half past eight.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 電影在八點半開始。

grammar.sentence: Dad washed his hands before he cooked dinner.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 爸爸煮晚餐前先洗了手。

grammar.sentence: The fox was hiding behind the tree then.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 狐狸當時正躲在樹後。

grammar.sentence: When I saw the snake, I ran away.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我看到蛇時就跑走了。

grammar.sentence: Were you listening when the teacher called you?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 老師叫你時，你有在聽嗎？

grammar.sentence: We went out after the wind stopped.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 風停了之後，我們才出門。

grammar.sentence: My sister was dancing while I was singing.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我唱歌時，妹妹正在跳舞。

grammar.sentence: It is now five minutes to twelve.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 現在是十一點五十五分。

grammar.sentence: The tired boy was not running then.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那個疲倦的男孩當時沒有在跑步。

grammar.sentence: Before I went downstairs, I closed the window.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我下樓前先關了窗戶。

grammar.sentence: Where was the rat hiding at that time?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 老鼠那時正躲在哪裡？

grammar.sentence: We were playing when Grandma finally arrived.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 奶奶終於到達時，我們正在玩。

grammar.sentence: The little girl arrived at ten past nine.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那個小女孩在九點十分到達。

grammar.sentence: While Mom was reading, I was drawing butterflies.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 媽媽讀書時，我正在畫蝴蝶。

grammar.sentence: I gave it another try after lunch.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 午餐後，我又試了一次。

cloze_quiz.question: The man wore a crown and ruled the country. He was the ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: crown 是王冠，ruled the country 是統治國家；兩者指向 king（國王）。

cloze_quiz.question: The animal looks like a frog, but it has rough, dry skin. It is a ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 外形像青蛙、皮膚粗糙的動物是 toad（蟾蜍）。

cloze_quiz.question: This road is the only ___ to the village. Follow it to get there.
cloze_quiz.hint: road 和 Follow it to get there 表示通往村莊的路，因此選 way（路；路線）。

cloze_quiz.question: My socks are ___ because I stepped into a pool of water.
cloze_quiz.hint: stepped into a pool of water 表示踩進水裡，所以襪子是 wet（溼的）。

cloze_quiz.question: After the rain, the soil mixed with water and became soft ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: soil mixed with water 是土與水混合，形成 mud（泥巴）。

cloze_quiz.question: We had no warning. The quiet dog ___ barked and made us jump.
cloze_quiz.hint: had no warning 和 made us jump 表示毫無預警、嚇了一跳，因此選 suddenly（突然地）。

cloze_quiz.question: The pool is three meters ___. Small children must not enter it alone.
cloze_quiz.hint: three meters 描述水池深度，對應 deep（深的）。

cloze_quiz.question: There is a ___ in my sock, and I can see my toe through it.
cloze_quiz.hint: can see my toe through it 表示襪子破了一個 hole（洞）。

cloze_quiz.question: The sad child began to ___, and tears ran down her face.
cloze_quiz.hint: sad 和 tears 是傷心流淚的線索，選 cry（哭）。

cloze_quiz.question: To reach our school, you must ___ the post office without stopping.
cloze_quiz.hint: without stopping 表示不停止、從郵局旁經過，go by 就是經過。

cloze_quiz.question: May sat right ___ me, so we could share the same book.
cloze_quiz.hint: 能共看同一本書，表示 May 坐在我旁邊，選 beside（在……旁邊）。

cloze_quiz.question: Please arrive ___ eight. We start at eight, and you need time to find a seat first.
cloze_quiz.hint: 需要先找座位，因此要在八點開始之前到，選 before（在……之前）。

cloze_quiz.question: This math problem is very ___. Nobody in our class can solve it.
cloze_quiz.hint: Nobody can solve it 表示沒人解得出來，題目很 difficult（困難的）。

cloze_quiz.question: I played the same song ___—about ten times—until I remembered every word.
cloze_quiz.hint: about ten times 表示重複很多次，over and over 是一遍又一遍。

cloze_quiz.question: A colorful insect with large wings landed on the flower. It was a ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: colorful insect、large wings 和 flower 指向 butterfly（蝴蝶）。

cloze_quiz.question: The funny story made everyone ___ with joy.
cloze_quiz.hint: funny story 和 with joy 表示開心地笑，因此選 laugh。

cloze_quiz.question: It is ___ to finish today. We still have enough time.
cloze_quiz.hint: still have enough time 表示時間足夠、做得到，因此選 possible（可能的）。

cloze_quiz.question: Please ___ the library on your walk here and check whether it is open; you do not need to go inside.
cloze_quiz.hint: on your walk here 和 do not need to go inside 表示經過圖書館即可，選 pass by。

cloze_quiz.question: The cat is high in the tree. We need to ___ up to reach it.
cloze_quiz.hint: high in the tree 和 up to reach it 表示要往上爬，選 climb（攀爬）。

cloze_quiz.question: The coin sank through the water and rested at the ___ of the pool.
cloze_quiz.hint: sank through the water 表示硬幣沉下去，最後停在泳池底部 bottom。

cloze_quiz.question: Plants may ___ if they get no water for a long time.
cloze_quiz.hint: 長時間沒有水可能使植物 die（死亡；枯死）。

cloze_quiz.question: I walked for five hours. Now I am ___ and need a rest.
cloze_quiz.hint: walked for five hours 和 need a rest 指疲倦，需要休息，因此選 tired。

cloze_quiz.question: The injured bird could not move or save itself. It was ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: could not move or save itself 表示無法自救，因此是 helpless（無助的）。

cloze_quiz.question: We tried to open the box many times. On our last try, it ___ opened.
cloze_quiz.hint: many times 和 last try 表示多次嘗試後終於成功，選 finally（終於）。

cloze_quiz.question: Our flight will ___ in Taipei at noon. Please meet us at the airport.
cloze_quiz.hint: flight、Taipei 和 meet us at the airport 指班機到達，選 arrive。

cloze_quiz.question: The train left at ten. We got there at 9:59 and caught it ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 9:59 在十點發車前，且成功搭上，表示 in time（及時）。

cloze_quiz.question: I did not know about the party, so I was ___ to see all my friends there.
cloze_quiz.hint: 不知道有派對卻看到所有朋友，表示感到 surprised（驚訝的）。

cloze_quiz.question: The animal has a long body, no legs, and scales on its skin. It is a ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: long body、no legs 和 scales 指向 snake（蛇）。

cloze_quiz.question: Use the keyboard to ___ your name into the computer.
cloze_quiz.hint: keyboard 是鍵盤，用鍵盤輸入姓名就是 type（打字）。

cloze_quiz.question: There is a new ___ on my phone. It says, “Please call Mom.”
cloze_quiz.hint: It says 後有文字內容，表示手機上有一則 message（訊息）。

cloze_quiz.question: I used my ___ to call Dad while I was walking outside.
cloze_quiz.hint: call Dad 和 walking outside 指用可攜式電話通話，選 cellphone（手機）。

cloze_quiz.question: The man cannot hear any sound because he is ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: cannot hear any sound 表示聽不見，選 deaf。

cloze_quiz.question: Please speak louder. I cannot ___ your voice over the music.
cloze_quiz.hint: speak louder 和 voice 指聲音聽不清楚，選 hear（聽見）。

cloze_quiz.question: Our players are running toward the finish line. Let’s ___ by shouting, “You can do it!”
cloze_quiz.hint: You can do it! 是鼓勵選手的話；cheer + 人 + on 表示替某人加油。them 指正在跑向終點的選手。

cloze_quiz.question: This animal sleeps upside down and flies at night. It is a ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: sleeps upside down 和 flies at night 指蝙蝠 bat。

cloze_quiz.question: The wild animal looks like a small dog and has a big, bushy tail. It is a ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 像小狗、有蓬鬆大尾巴的動物是 fox（狐狸）。

cloze_quiz.question: The animal looks like a large mouse and has a long tail. It is a ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: looks like a large mouse 表示像大隻老鼠，選 rat。

cloze_quiz.question: The farmer keeps this female chicken for its eggs. It is a ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: female chicken 和 eggs 指母雞 hen。
